dynamic_line.gendered_line: Well now, that's quite a kind offer, and I appreciate you looking past my full-body pubic hair.  Sorry though.  I've come to feel sort of responsible for this little gaggle of squatters.  As long as I'm the only one providing for them, I don't think I can leave.

responses.text: I've spoken to all your friends, and except for Dave, they're good to go.  Dave wants to stay here.  How about you?

dynamic_line: Huh.  Getting those three to sign on to a suicide mission is quite the feat… sounds like you're pretty dedicated to this.  OK, I'm with you.  Let's round up the others and hit the road.
